fullText.simplified:
第3章、投降

    曹仁的兵被大水冲走了，他觉得河边一定还有人在等着自己。
    “曹仁，我来杀你！”又一队人马从路边的树和草里面杀了出来。
    没错，还是刘备的人，这次是张飞。
    曹仁和他的兵只能再跑，他们跑得太急，身上还有水，衣服也没穿好。
    张飞大笑着说：“曹仁你也太胆小了！”
    曹仁不敢说话，也不敢向后看，他骑着马跑了一个晚上，一直到天亮，才发现张飞已经没在后面了。
    曹仁安全了，但他的十万大军没有了。
    曹操听说曹仁败了，生气极了，马上要另一个将军带更多人去杀刘备。
    有个助手对曹操说：“大人，您想得到荆州，应该先得到荆州人的心。现在刘备已经到了凡城，您可以先对刘备说，您不想打仗。只要刘备投降，您就不用打凡城了，城里的人就都是安全的，这样您就能得到凡城人的心。”
    曹操想了想，问：“如果刘备不投降呢？”
    助手说：“如果刘备不投降，您再打。这样凡城人会觉得，虽然您打了，但您只想打刘备，不想打城里的人，他们的心还是在您这儿的。”
    曹操又问：“如果刘备投降呢？”
    助手笑着说：“如果刘备投降，那就最好了。这样您不用打，就能得到凡城。别的人看到厉害的刘备都投降了，他们也会跟着投降，这样得到荆州就容易多了。”
    曹操问：“那让谁去和刘备说呢？”
    助手想了想，说：“徐元直。他以前为刘备做过事，他了解刘备，知道怎么和刘备说话，刘备也会听他的话。”
    曹操说：“好吧，就让徐元直去。十年前我就应该杀了刘备的，留到现在，麻烦越来越大。这一次，不管他是投降还是不投降，我都不会再留他了。”
fullText.traditional:
第3章、投降

    曹仁的兵被大水沖走了，他覺得河邊一定還有人在等著自己。
    “曹仁，我來殺你！”又一隊人馬從路邊的樹和草裡面殺了出來。
    沒錯，還是劉備的人，這次是張飛。
    曹仁和他的兵只能再跑，他們跑得太急，身上還有水，衣服也沒穿好。
    張飛大笑著說：“曹仁你也太膽小了！”
    曹仁不敢說話，也不敢向後看，他騎著馬跑了一個晚上，一直到天亮，才發現張飛已經沒在後面了。
    曹仁安全了，但他的十萬大軍沒有了。
    曹操聽說曹仁敗了，生氣極了，馬上要另一個將軍帶更多人去殺劉備。
    有個助手對曹操說：“大人，您想得到荊州，應該先得到荊州人的心。現在劉備已經到了凡城，您可以先對劉備說，您不想打仗。只要劉備投降，您就不用打凡城了，城裡的人就都是安全的，這樣您就能得到凡城人的心。”
    曹操想了想，問：“如果劉備不投降呢？”
    助手說：“如果劉備不投降，您再打。這樣凡城人會覺得，雖然您打了，但您只想打劉備，不想打城裡的人，他們的心還是在您這兒的。”
    曹操又問：“如果劉備投降呢？”
    助手笑著說：“如果劉備投降，那就最好了。這樣您不用打，就能得到凡城。別的人看到厲害的劉備都投降了，他們也會跟著投降，這樣得到荊州就容易多了。”
    曹操問：“那讓誰去和劉備說呢？”
    助手想了想，說：“徐元直。他以前為劉備做過事，他了解劉備，知道怎麼和劉備說話，劉備也會聽他的話。”
    曹操說：“好吧，就讓徐元直去。十年前我就應該殺了劉備的，留到現在，麻煩越來越大。這一次，不管他是投降還是不投降，我都不會再留他了。”

sentences.english: Indeed, it was still Liu Bei’s men. This time it was Zhang Fei.

sentences.traditional: 曹仁和他的兵只能再跑，他們跑得太急，身上還有水，衣服也沒穿好。

sentences.english: Cao Ren and his soldiers could only flee again. They fled too hastily; they were still wet, and they had not put on their clothes properly.

sentences.simplified: 张飞大笑着说：“曹仁你也太胆小了！”
sentences.traditional: 張飛大笑著說：“曹仁你也太膽小了！”
sentences.pinyin: zhāng fēi dà xiào zhe shuō cáo rén nǐ yě tài dǎn xiǎo le
sentences.english: Zhang Fei laughed loudly and said, “Cao Ren, you are too cowardly!”

sentences.simplified: 曹仁不敢说话，也不敢向后看，
sentences.traditional: 曹仁不敢說話，也不敢向後看，
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén bù gǎn shuō huà yě bù gǎn xiàng hòu kàn
sentences.english: Cao Ren didn’t dare say anything, nor did he dare to look behind him.

sentences.simplified: 他骑着马跑了一个晚上，一直到天亮，才发现张飞已经没在后面了。
sentences.traditional: 他騎著馬跑了一個晚上，一直到天亮，才發現張飛已經沒在後面了。

sentences.english: He rode on horseback through the entire night until dawn. Only then did he notice that Zhang Fei was no longer behind him.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁安全了，但他的十万大军没有了。
sentences.traditional: 曹仁安全了，但他的十萬大軍沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén ān quán le dàn tā de shí wàn dà jūn méi yǒu le
sentences.english: Cao Ren was safe, but his army of 100,000 was gone.

sentences.traditional: 曹操聽說曹仁敗了，生氣極了，

sentences.english: Cao Cao heard that Cao Ren had been defeated and was extremely angry.

sentences.english: He immediately sought another general to bring more men to go and kill Liu Bei.

sentences.english: All the people in the city will be safe. This way, you can win over the hearts of the people of Fancheng.”

sentences.english: Their hearts will still be with you.”

sentences.traditional: 曹操又問：“如果劉備投降呢？”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yòu wèn rú guǒ liú bèi tóu xiáng ne
sentences.english: Cao Cao asked again, “What if Liu Bei surrenders?”

sentences.traditional: 助手笑著說：“如果劉備投降，那就最好了。
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu xiào zhe shuō rú guǒ liú bèi tóu xiáng nà jiù zuì hǎo le
sentences.english: The assistant said, smiling, “If Liu Bei surrenders, that would be ideal.

sentences.simplified: 这样您不用打，就能得到凡城。
sentences.traditional: 這樣您不用打，就能得到凡城。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng nín bú yòng dǎ jiù néng dé dào fán chéng
sentences.english: This way, you can take Fancheng without having to fight.

sentences.traditional: 別的人看到厲害的劉備都投降了，他們也會跟著投降，

sentences.english: When other people see that even the formidable Liu Bei has surrendered, they will follow suit and also surrender.

sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng dé dào jīng zhōu jiù róng yì duō le
sentences.english: This way, it will be much easier to take Jingzhou.”

sentences.traditional: 曹操說：“好吧，就讓徐元直去。

sentences.english: Cao Cao said, “Okay, let’s have Xu Yuanzhi go.

sentences.traditional: 十年前我就應該殺了劉備的，留到現在，麻煩越來越大。

sentences.english: I should have killed Liu Bei ten years ago. Waiting until now has given us more and more trouble.

sentences.english: This time, I won’t spare him whether he surrenders or not.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 3: Surrender
Cao Ren’s soldiers were swept away by the floodwater.
He felt that there must still be people next to the river waiting for him.
“Cao Ren, I’m going to kill you!” Another group of men and horses came rushing out of the trees and grass off the side of the road.
Indeed, it was still Liu Bei’s men. This time it was Zhang Fei.
Cao Ren and his soldiers could only flee again. They fled too hastily; they were still wet, and they had not put on their clothes properly.
Zhang Fei laughed loudly and said, “Cao Ren, you are too cowardly!”
Cao Ren didn’t dare say anything, nor did he dare to look behind him.
He rode on horseback through the entire night until dawn. Only then did he notice that Zhang Fei was no longer behind him.
Cao Ren was safe, but his army of 100,000 was gone.
Cao Cao heard that Cao Ren had been defeated and was extremely angry.
He immediately sought another general to bring more men to go and kill Liu Bei.
An assistant said to Cao Cao, “Lord, if you want to win Jingzhou, then you should first win over the hearts of the people of Jingzhou.
Now that Liu Bei has arrived in Fancheng, for now, you can tell Liu Bei that you don’t want to fight.
As long as Liu Bei surrenders, you won’t have to fight Fancheng.
All the people in the city will be safe. This way, you can win over the hearts of the people of Fancheng.”
Cao Cao thought about it and asked, “What if Liu Bei doesn’t surrender?”
The assistant said, “If Liu Bei doesn’t surrender, then fight him.
This way, the people of Fancheng will think that even though you fought, you only wanted to fight Liu Bei and not the people of the city.
Their hearts will still be with you.”
Cao Cao asked again, “What if Liu Bei surrenders?”
The assistant said, smiling, “If Liu Bei surrenders, that would be ideal.
This way, you can take Fancheng without having to fight.
When other people see that even the formidable Liu Bei has surrendered, they will follow suit and also surrender.
This way, it will be much easier to take Jingzhou.”
Cao Cao asked, “Then who should go to tell Liu Bei?”
The assistant thought about it and said, ..
.. “Xu Yuanzhi. He worked for Liu Bei before. He understands Liu Bei and knows how to talk to him. Liu Bei will listen to him.”
Cao Cao said, “Okay, let’s have Xu Yuanzhi go.
I should have killed Liu Bei ten years ago. Waiting until now has given us more and more trouble.
This time, I won’t spare him whether he surrenders or not.”
